title: HistoryBucketed1mParams
description: Server-side time-bucket aggregate sourced from the `_1m` continuous aggregate. Returns one row per minute-bucket with min/max/avg/count of the point's value. Same shape as `history_bucketed` for caller compatibility — but pre-aggregated, so a 24-hour chart hits ~1,440 rows instead of potentially millions. `tenant_id` is not declared here: the host injects `$caller_tenant_id` from the operator session.
